title: Schema Stitching Configuration Structure
description: Document structure for configuring a GraphQL schema stitching gateway.

subschemas.description: Array of remote or local GraphQL subschemas to stitch together.

items.schema: GraphQL schema SDL or executable schema object

TypeName.selectionSet: Key fields selection set e.g. { id }
TypeName.fieldName: Query field to fetch merged type
TypeName.argsFromKeys: Map keys to query args function
TypeName.key: Extract merge key from object function

items.transforms: Array of schema transforms (rename, filter, wrap)

schema_extensions.description: Traditional delegation method using extend keyword in typeDefs
schema_extensions.use_case: Adding cross-service fields to existing types

programmatic_type_merging.description: Code-based configuration of type merging in subschema config
programmatic_type_merging.use_case: Merging distributed entity types by shared key
